'''2007 Worlds Team Kevin Shannon LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Tournament. Senate suite; Throne Room (V) → Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
